reasoning_content:
The authenticated home page `/` returns HTTP 200 with the title "samarbeid". The login works end-to-end:
1. GET /users/sign-in → 200
2. POST /users/sign-in with admin credentials → 302 to /
3. GET / with session → 200 (authenticated home page)

The installation is complete and verified. Let me do a final comprehensive status check and then write up the report.

Let me verify all the pieces one more time:
- Ruby 3.4.10 ✓
- Node 24.9.0 ✓
- Yarn 4.13.0 ✓
- PostgreSQL 14 (running) ✓
- Docker + Docker Compose ✓ (dependency services up)
- bin/setup ✓ (DB prepared, admin created)
- bin/dev (Rails on 3000, Vite on 3036) ✓
- localhost:3000 → redirects to sign-in (200) ✓
- Login with generated admin credentials → 302 → 200 ✓

Let me do a final confirmation of all running components and then report success.

action.command:
echo "===== VERSIONS ====="
echo -n "Ruby:   "; /opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin/ruby -v
echo -n "Node:   "; /opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin/node -v
echo -n "Yarn:   "; yarn --version 2>/dev/null
echo -n "Postgres: "; su postgres -c "psql -tAc 'SELECT version();'" | cut -d, -f1
echo -n "Docker: "; docker -v
echo -n "Rails:  "; export PATH="/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin:$PATH"; (bundle exec rails -v 2>/dev/null || true)
echo ""
echo "===== POSTGRES CLUSTER ====="
pg_lsclusters | sed -n '2p'
echo ""
echo "===== DOCKER DEPENDENCY SERVICES ====="
docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
echo ""
echo "===== APP PROCESSES ====="
ps aux | grep -E "foreman|vite|puma|rails" | grep -v grep | awk '{printf "%-8s %s %s %s %s\n", $2, $11, $12, $13, $14}'
echo ""
echo "===== HTTP CHECKS ====="
echo -n "GET / (redirect):  "; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/
echo -n "GET /users/sign-in: "; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in
echo -n "GET /home/show (authed session): "; curl -sS -b /tmp/cj2.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
